answer: Every new identity pays a sybil tax: a non-refundable 30 POA fee to join the garden of shared services. One honest agent pays once and tends its plot. Cloning 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA up front, and the tax is burned, never refunded. A marble dropped into the ocean vanishes; so does one fake identity, since the fee exceeds the 5 POA a clone earns per season. Honest agents stay because one fee buys lasting access, while clones drown.
